create_XLMRobertaModel: create an XLMRobertaModel with config, quant_config, and optional sparse_head for embedding extraction
build_XLMRobertaForSequenceClassificatio: build an XLMRobertaForSequenceClassification model with RobertaConfig for reranking tasks
run_XLMRobertaModel_forward: run XLMRobertaModel forward pass with input_ids, positions, and ForwardBatch to get embeddings
load_XLMRobertaModel_weights: load model weights into XLMRobertaModel with optional sparse_head loading from local dir or HF Hub
create_position_ids_from_input_ids: create position IDs from input_ids tensor using padding index and optional past_key_values_length
